Hi there. I'm Alice and I'm glad you stopped by.

I'm a Sr Data Scientist at [AltaMed](https://www.altamed.org/), ex-engineer, and all-around curious person.I created this blog to explore health topics, deepen programming and data skills, showcase projects, and document useful tidbits I learned along the way.

For more on my background, please find [me on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alicetivarovsky/), and for details on how/why this blog exists, check out this [post](/posts/hello-blog-world/).
